AI voice agent for your call centre

Picks up incoming calls with no queue, in Uzbek and Russian, takes orders and bookings, and transfers to an operator when needed. An MVP in 6–10 weeks, from UZS 96 mln; the full version in 14–24 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

Who it is for
Clinics, Restaurants and cafes, Delivery services, Banks, Telecom and internet providers, Service businesses, Car services and dealers

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • One narrow scenario (for example booking or order status) on your existing number via SIP
  • Speech recognition and synthesis in Uzbek and Russian
  • Transfer to a person
  • Recordings and transcripts of every call
What the full version adds
  • Several scenarios
  • Lookups in your CRM and booking system
  • Payment links by SMS or Telegram after the call
  • Call-reason analytics
  • Script A/B tests
  • Capacity for peak hours
Please note

Uzbek speech recognition is less accurate than Russian, especially with mixed speech and street noise. We test on your real call recordings and agree an accuracy target before launch.

What we need from you

  • Sample data: questions, documents or chats
  • Answer rules and topics to avoid
  • A person who checks the results
